definitions.long_source: Same non-E saved final route lasts at least4 consecutive actual sampled nodes. Event-interior counts additionally require active and unobserved.
definitions.positive_route_bias: At least one saved candidate route-bias entry is greater than1e-12.
definitions.chosen_positive_route_bias: The actually selected candidate has saved positive route bias.
definitions.actual_replacement: Final saved box differs from E in at least one coordinate; inactive nodes must retain E.
definitions.commit_suppression: The quality/witness gate suppresses commitment write and route support; original legal candidate choices remain available.

limitations: Saved final route persistence, positive route bias and selected non-E boxes establish that the mechanism is active on these paths, not GT benefit.
No route-removal ablation was run, so co-occurring positive route bias does not prove the route caused the selected action.
Final counterevidence reset events are zero in all three methods; no real reset benefit is established by these final paths.
Direct full-gradient correctness is supported by frozen-source inspection and synthetic derivative tests, not by detached saved traces alone.

formula.student: logprior + saved student_features @ final_effective_weights + fixed saved route_bias
formula.coefficient_space: Four shared effective weights in(0,4); the closed[0,4] box provides a supremum upper bound.
formula.teacher_target: Argmax of existing final teacherq; no new Q evaluation.

limitations: The upper bound holds conditional on this exact saved incoming history and route bias. Different weights can alter earlier actions and history; this does not prove whole-trajectory impossibility.
Each node is maximized independently. A positive bound does not guarantee one shared four-weight vector can satisfy all target nodes simultaneously.
Teacher target E is reported separately and excluded from the cannot-beat-E count; its self-margin0 is not an expressivity failure.
No labels, GT IoU, new paths, new Q, fit or parameter search are used.
